verdict.rationale: Granola's docs describe this story almost word for word. After an external meeting it automatically drafts a follow-up email from the transcript, calendar and past Gmail threads so it can be sent in a couple of clicks. Granola Chat can also draft and send follow-ups, with a review step before anything is sent. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the auto-drafted follow-up email (all evidence is first-party docs), and the auto-draft is documented only for external meetings.

support.subject: As a sales lead, the tool drafts my follow-up email from the meeting so I can review and send it in a couple of clicks

citations.quote: After an external meeting, Granola can automatically draft a follow-up email - using context from your transcript, calendar, and past Gmail threads - so you can send it in a couple of clicks.
Use Granola Chat to draft follow-up emails, send Slack messages, and schedule Google Calendar events — with a review step before anything is sent or created.
